Character.Name: Lumen
Character.Description: Lumen is the Field lead of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Field lead

Character.Name: Hemlock
Character.Description: Hemlock is the Quartermaster of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. keeps the crew supplied and knows which kit can be repaired in the field. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Quartermaster

Character.Name: Gauze
Character.Description: Gauze is the Pathfinder of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. reads routes, sightlines, and exits before the rest of the crew arrives. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Pathfinder

Character.Name: Sterile
Character.Description: Sterile is the Riflehand of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. holds a steady lane and calls out changing enemy positions. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Riflehand

Character.Name: Stitch
Character.Description: Stitch is the Bulwark of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. takes the exposed approach so lighter crew members can reposition. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Bulwark

Character.Name: Anodyne
Character.Description: Anodyne is the Mechanic of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. keeps radios, doors, lifts, and improvised tools working under pressure. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Mechanic

Character.Name: Belladonna
Character.Description: Belladonna is the Medic of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. stabilizes injured crew and refuses to leave anyone behind. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Medic

Character.Name: Suture
Character.Description: Suture is the Marksman of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. spots threats early and shares a clean shot with the rest of the team. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Marksman

Character.Name: Vial
Character.Description: Vial is the Runner of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. moves messages and supplies through gaps the larger crew cannot use. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Runner

Character.Name: Bandage
Character.Description: Bandage is the Trainee of the Afterlight Clinic, working the mobile wards and ruined triage stations. is the newest member, learning the route from people who trust them. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: weathered bone-white panels with clinic-green markings.
Character.Title: Trainee

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Lumen. medic-first calls with calm triage, status reports, and direct safety instructions.
Spawned: Lumen, Field lead, reporting from the mobile wards and ruined triage stations.
WakeUp: Lumen, eyes up. Afterlight Clinic still has work to finish.
Attacking: Lumen taking the field lead lane. treat first, argue later.
Chasing: Lumen on the pursuit. Keep my signal as I push them toward the the mobile wards and ruined triage stations.
Waiting: Lumen holding at the Afterlight staging point. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: Lumen here. We lost one of ours; I'll cover the crew while you mark the spot.
EnemyDown: Lumen confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Lumen is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Lumen signing off. Tell the Afterlight Clinic crew I kept my word.
Chatter.Name: Lumen - Afterlight Clinic combat chatter
